interface.title: Censor Check (99 Small Problems No. 06, companion to The Audit No. 1 'Where the Inactives Went')
interface.field: Medicinal chemistry / cheminformatics: curating bioactivity (IC50) data from ChEMBL and the literature
interface.stage_of_work: Data curation and checking: auditing a potency dataset before modelling or meta-analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Shows what a pChEMBL-style exact-value filter removes from an IC50 table, and uses pooled and per-paper censored-normal (Tobit) models, a pooled-versus-within-paper comparison of two targets and a top-value tie test to estimate the resulting bias.

data.note: Most work used the bundled ChEMBL subset: 31,236 journal IC50 records over six targets (Thrombin, ABL1, AKT1, BACE1, VEGFR2, HDAC1). This set loads and runs on its own when the page opens. The upload path was also tested with the provided sample-ic50.csv: 30 rows, two strata (KINASE_X and KINASE_Y), all columns matched automatically, 22 exact, 7 '>', 1 '<' and 1 validity-flagged record. The page is fully client-side, and its downloads were read back: censor-check-summary.csv, censor-check-results.json and censor-check-weak-tail.png.

tree.general: Find out how much evidence of weak activity a dataset loses when only exact measurements are kept, and how much that biases potency estimates and comparisons
tree.specific: Audit an IC50 table for what the pChEMBL exact-value filter removes, fit censored-normal models, compare targets pooled versus within-paper, and test for disguised ceilings

features.name: Censoring-aware filter audit with threshold and group minimums

features.specific: Set Weakness threshold (nM), Min records / paper and Min exact for shift, press 'Run the check', and read the headline sentence ('…% of the weak evidence is a bound') with its status badge (e.g. TAIL MOSTLY CENSORED, which was still shown at 33.8%), the four tiles (weak share for all evidence versus after the filter, papers losing their whole weak tail, median overstatement) and the Filter accounting table (exact, right- and left-censored, validity-flagged, kept, pairs known only through bounds)
steps: Type a weakness threshold in nM
Set the minimum records per paper and minimum exact values for the shift
Press Run the check
Read the headline sentence and badge, the tiles and the accounting table; change a setting and rerun to see its effect

features.name: Before/after paired bar chart with an eligibility filter
features.general: Show each category's rate before and after a filter as paired horizontal bars, with a checkbox that limits the data to groups able to show the effect
features.specific: 'Share of records weaker than the threshold' chart with teal (all evidence) and orange (after exact-value filter) bars per target, and the 'Only papers whose reported values reach the threshold' checkbox switching the badge between ALL PAPERS and PAPERS THAT REACH THE THRESHOLD
steps: Run the audit to draw paired bars per stratum
Tick the eligibility checkbox to recompute on the eligible papers only
Compare bar lengths and the rescaled axis
Untick to return to all papers

features.name: Pooled and grouped censored-normal (Tobit) fit with per-group shift histogram
features.general: Fit a censored-normal model pooled and with one mean per group, compare it with naive estimates, and plot the distribution of per-group bias with its median
features.specific: Estimates table (exact-only mean, bounds substituted, pooled censored mean and SD with overstatement, predicted weak share, within- and between-paper SD), cards for variance split and record- versus paper-weighting, and the 'Per-paper overstatement' histogram with median line and IQR caption
steps: Run the check so both models are fitted
Read the estimates table to compare censored and naive means
Read the histogram of per-paper shifts and its median and IQR
Raise or lower Min exact for shift and rerun to see which papers enter the histogram
serves_tasks: Compare a censored-likelihood estimate against naive estimates

features.name: Top-value tie test for disguised ceilings

features.specific: Disguised Ceilings cards: 'Ties at the top' (share of paper sets with ≥8 exact values whose top values tie), 'Ties in the interior' (expected tie rate) and 'Same ceiling written both ways' (paper sets); all read n/a when no paper has ≥8 exact values
steps: Run the check
Scroll to the Disguised Ceilings section
Compare the top-tie rate with the interior tie rate
Read the count of ceilings written both ways
